question: Average attendance per course this term?
gold_sql: SELECT dc.course_code, ROUND(AVG(fa.attendance_pct), 1) FROM fact_attendance fa, dim_course dc, dim_term dt WHERE fa.course_id = dc.course_id AND fa.term_id = dt.term_id AND dt.term_name = '2026-ODD' GROUP BY dc.course_code

question: Average score per assessment type in CS2102 this term
gold_sql: SELECT x.assessment_type, ROUND(AVG(x.score_pct), 1) FROM fact_assessment x WHERE x.course_id = (SELECT course_id FROM dim_course WHERE course_code = 'CS2102') AND x.term_id = (SELECT term_id FROM dim_term WHERE term_name = '2026-ODD') GROUP BY x.assessment_type

question: How many students are in each program?
gold_sql: SELECT program, COUNT(student_id) FROM dim_student GROUP BY program

question: Average attendance per section of CS2101 this term?
gold_sql: SELECT s.section_name, ROUND(AVG(a.attendance_pct), 1), COUNT(DISTINCT a.student_id) FROM fact_attendance a JOIN dim_section s USING (section_id) WHERE a.course_id = (SELECT course_id FROM dim_course WHERE course_code = 'CS2101') AND a.term_id = (SELECT term_id FROM dim_term WHERE term_name = '2026-ODD') GROUP BY s.section_name

question: How has attendance changed across terms?
gold_sql: SELECT t.term_name, ROUND(AVG(a.attendance_pct), 1) FROM fact_attendance a JOIN dim_term t USING (term_id) GROUP BY t.term_name

question: What is the pass rate per course this term?
gold_sql: SELECT c.course_code, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN f.score_pct >= 40 THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END), 1) FROM fact_assessment f JOIN dim_course c USING (course_id) JOIN dim_term t USING (term_id) WHERE t.term_name = '2026-ODD' AND f.assessment_type = 'End-semester' GROUP BY c.course_code

question: Average marks per section for MA2101 this term
gold_sql: SELECT s.section_name, ROUND(AVG(f.score_pct), 1) FROM fact_assessment f JOIN dim_section s USING (section_id) JOIN dim_course c USING (course_id) JOIN dim_term t USING (term_id) WHERE c.course_code = 'MA2101' AND t.term_name = '2026-ODD' GROUP BY s.section_name

question: How many students have attendance below 75% in each course this term?
gold_sql: SELECT c.course_code, COUNT(*) FROM fact_attendance a JOIN dim_course c USING (course_id) JOIN dim_term t USING (term_id) WHERE t.term_name = '2026-ODD' AND a.attendance_pct < 75 GROUP BY c.course_code

question: Average marks per course this term
gold_sql: SELECT c.course_code, ROUND(AVG(f.score_pct), 1) FROM fact_assessment f JOIN dim_course c USING (course_id) JOIN dim_term t USING (term_id) WHERE t.term_name = '2026-ODD' GROUP BY c.course_code

question: What is the average attendance in CS2103 this term?
gold_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(a.attendance_pct), 1), COUNT(DISTINCT a.student_id) FROM fact_attendance a JOIN dim_course c USING (course_id) JOIN dim_term t USING (term_id) WHERE c.course_code = 'CS2103' AND t.term_name = '2026-ODD'

question: Average end-semester score by attendance band this term
gold_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN a.attendance_pct >= 90 THEN '90-100%' WHEN a.attendance_pct >= 75 THEN '75-89%' ELSE 'below 75%' END AS band, COUNT(*), ROUND(AVG(f.score_pct), 1) FROM fact_assessment f JOIN fact_attendance a ON a.student_id = f.student_id AND a.course_id = f.course_id AND a.term_id = f.term_id JOIN dim_term t ON t.term_id = f.term_id WHERE t.term_name = '2026-ODD' AND f.assessment_type = 'End-semester' GROUP BY band

question: Which course has the biggest drop from quiz to end-semester score this term?
gold_sql: SELECT c.course_code, ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN f.assessment_type = 'Quiz' THEN f.score_pct END) - AVG(CASE WHEN f.assessment_type = 'End-semester' THEN f.score_pct END), 1) AS drop_pct FROM fact_assessment f JOIN dim_course c USING (course_id) JOIN dim_term t USING (term_id) WHERE t.term_name = '2026-ODD' GROUP BY c.course_code ORDER BY drop_pct DESC LIMIT 1
